    LargeIndecomposable.RayQuiver.MulBasis.not_zigzag_forks

    Zigzags with forks: D̃ cleaving diagrams #

    An ℕ-indexed chain (RayCat.ZChain) has objects x t, z t and morphisms ρ t : x t ⟶ z t, σ t : x (t + 1) ⟶ z t with the peak and valley conditions. A segment of length L + 1 from x p to x (p + L + 1), with two extra morphisms out of each end, is a bipartite diagram of type D̃ (RayCat.ZV, RayCat.zgraph). If it avoids τ and the forks satisfy the zigzag conditions, it contradicts minimality (RayQuiver.MulBasis.not_zigzag_forks; BO13a figure 5.1).

    structure LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.ZChain (Q : Type) [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} Q] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms Q] :
    Type

    An ℕ-indexed chain: peaks ρ t, σ t at z t, valleys σ t, ρ (t+1) at x (t+1).

    • x : ℕ → Q
    • z : ℕ → Q
    • ρ (t : ℕ) : self.x t ⟶ self.z t
    • σ (t : ℕ) : self.x (t + 1) ⟶ self.z t
    • ρ_ne (t : ℕ) : self.ρ t ≠ 0
    • σ_ne (t : ℕ) : self.σ t ≠ 0
    • peak₁ (t : ℕ) : ¬∃ (c : self.x t ⟶ self.x (t + 1)), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp c (self.σ t) = self.ρ t
    • peak₂ (t : ℕ) : ¬∃ (c : self.x (t + 1) ⟶ self.x t), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp c (self.ρ t) = self.σ t
    • valley₁ (t : ℕ) : ¬∃ (c : self.z t ⟶ self.z (t + 1)), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (self.σ t) c = self.ρ (t + 1)
    • valley₂ (t : ℕ) : ¬∃ (c : self.z (t + 1) ⟶ self.z t), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (self.ρ (t + 1)) c = self.σ t
